WITH most_common AS (
  SELECT `behaviour_monitoring_details`, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rnk

),
common_detail AS (

  WHERE rnk = 1
),
student_behaviour AS (
  SELECT bm.`student_id`, s.`bio_data`, bm.`behaviour_monitoring_details`
  FROM `workspace`.`cre_students_information_systems`.`behaviour_monitoring` bm
  JOIN `workspace`.`cre_students_information_systems`.`students` s
    ON bm.`student_id` = s.`student_id`
  WHERE bm.`behaviour_monitoring_details` IS NOT NULL AND s.`bio_data` IS NOT NULL
),
student_check AS (
  SELECT sb.`student_id`, sb.`bio_data`, COUNT(DISTINCT sb.`behaviour_monitoring_details`) AS num_details,
         SUM(CASE WHEN sb.`behaviour_monitoring_details` IN (SELECT `behaviour_monitoring_details` FROM common_detail) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS num_common
  FROM student_behaviour sb
  GROUP BY sb.`student_id`, sb.`bio_data`
)
SELECT `student_id`, `bio_data`
FROM student_check
WHERE num_details = num_common
